summary: Recent updates to the negotiation engine in Firefox's JSEP (JavaScript Session Establishment Protocol) have improved how the browser handles errors related to SDP (Session Description Protocol) parsing. By introducing distinct error messages for parsing failures, developers can more easily identify and troubleshoot issues that arise during the establishment of multimedia sessions, such as video calls through WebRTC (the technology behind video calls). Additionally, applying `std::move` in various parts of the browser's code enhances performance by allowing the efficient transfer of data rather than duplicating it, leading to a smoother user experience without apparent _visible change_.
